gate: Gate-D step 2 (map-match candidates), candidate generation only
acceptance_note: owner_policy_accepted_candidate means the owner's written policy accepted the row. No analyst, human, or supervisor reviewed any row. docs/evaluation/supervisor_contract_decision_form.md remains unsigned.

inputs.network: accepted Greater Manchester baseline (ADR-059/060), 804,611 real road edges
inputs.motor_access_source: per-edge lane permissions read by network_connectivity, 804,611 entries

reconciliation_v1_0_versus_v1_1.monotonicity: v1.1 acceptance is exactly v1.0's 106 clear candidates plus 12 override rescues. v1.1 accepts nothing that v1.0 sent to review, and demotes nothing v1.0 accepted

override_outcome.guards_note: these four guards are implemented and adversarially tested, but no real Manchester site exercised them. Their absence here is a property of this data, not evidence that they are unnecessary.

underdetermined_rule_made_explicit.question: may the override also resolve a site where its group is the only one carrying the exact reference, but other eligible groups still compete on distance alone?
underdetermined_rule_made_explicit.why_it_is_underdetermined: the owner's policy says both that 'the signed reference must identify exactly one nearby road group' and that 'ambiguous rows remain review-required'. On this data the two readings disagree for 13 of 305 sites, one of them with 25 competing eligible groups.
underdetermined_rule_made_explicit.implemented_default: conservative - override_requires_sole_eligible_group = true. The override rescues a site the reference resolves outright and does not silently settle a many-way competition.
underdetermined_rule_made_explicit.owner_action_available: confirm the conservative default, or set override_requires_sole_eligible_group to false as a recorded policy choice. Either way the fingerprint changes, so results can never look identical under different rules.
underdetermined_rule_made_explicit.not_decided_here: the conservative reading was implemented because it is the one that can be relaxed later without retracting evidence already accepted. The choice remains the owner's.

correction_to_the_phase_2_finding.earlier_statement: the Phase 2 record noted that several of the 21 unmatched sites sit on the A56 (5 sites) and A6042 (4 sites) with a rejected edge less than a metre away, and listed an exact-reference override as an option
correction_to_the_phase_2_finding.what_the_override_actually_reached: 4 of the 5 A56 sites, and none of the 4 A6042 sites
correction_to_the_phase_2_finding.why_the_a6042_sites_were_not_reached: the nearby rejected edges at those sites carry no matching signed reference in OpenStreetMap at all. Every override consideration there refused with reference_not_exact, so an exact-reference rule cannot reach them by construction.
correction_to_the_phase_2_finding.consequence: the earlier framing implied the override would resolve both roads. It resolves one. Reaching the A6042 sites would need either a road-class widening or a name-based rule, and neither is authorised - fuzzy names are explicitly excluded from the override.

preserved_evidence.rejection_ledger_kept_whole: an override readmits a candidate without erasing the record that it was rejected first; every v1.0 rejection and reason is retained on the row
preserved_evidence.override_refusals_published: every family-rejected candidate the override examined and refused is published with its refusal reason, so the override's narrowness is auditable rather than asserted
preserved_evidence.family_mismatch_preserved: every override acceptance displays the DfT/OSM classification disagreement it proceeded despite, and the artifact refuses an override acceptance that drops it
preserved_evidence.audit_flag: every override acceptance carries audit_flag = true; a strict acceptance may not claim one
preserved_evidence.missing_evidence_never_zero: no observation was filled, defaulted, or converted to zero; 9 sites remain explicitly unavailable

explicit_non_claims: candidate generation is not human acceptance; no analyst reviewed any row
owner_policy_accepted_candidate is not analyst_accepted, not supervisor_approved, and not scientifically_validated
confidence is triage and is not a probability or a scientific confidence interval
no demand, calibration, comparison, or simulation was produced by this run
MAN-09 remains planned and Gate D remains foundation_only
